attributes.title: Level 4

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using loops in your projects to run a chunk of code until a specific condition is met.

questions.hint: What happens when a loop runs in a computer program?
questions.title: [Select one] In a computer program, what is a loop?

answers.text: A chunk of code that repeats until a specific condition is met
Code that uses the random value bubble
A chunk of code in which sequence does not matter

questions.correctResponse: Remember, using a loop, we can turn 1 cookie into 1 million cookies!

questions.hint: What tells the repeat loop how many times to repeat a chunk of code?
questions.title: [Select one] A repeat loop repeats code _______.

answers.text: Once every set number of seconds.
For the number of times specified in the parameter.

questions.correctResponse: A repeat loop has a number value parameter that tells it how many times to run the chunk of code.

questions.hint: What coding concept stores items, or values, into an ordered list?
questions.title: [Select one] A [for element] loop repeats code for each value within a(n) _______.
questions.correctResponse: A [for element] loop will perform an action on each element in an array.

questions.hint: Can a loop perform an action on each element in an array?
questions.title: [Select one] Loops are useful in accessing values and applying actions to those values within an array.
questions.correctResponse: A great example of this is the [for element] loop!

subgroups.title: Repeat and For Element Of Loops!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using loops in your projects to run a chunk of code until a specific condition is met.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of Orange Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about repeat and for loops. A loop is a chunk of code that repeats until a specific condition is met. You’ll use what you already know about variables and arrays to create loops that respond to specific conditions. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level #4:

badges.title: Deja Vu
badges.description: Use different types of loops to repeat code in a project.

badges.title: Once More, With Feeling
badges.description: Use a repeat loop to repeat code a given number of times.

badges.title: Yearbook
badges.description: Create and use an array of sprites.

badges.title: Roll Call
badges.description: Use a for element of loop to make something happen to each item in an array.

badges.title: Freeze Tag
badges.description: Use a pause in a project.

badges.title: Button Down
badges.description: Check if a button is being pressed before making something happen in a project.
